goal: Invoice delivery bağlantısının ürettiği belge URL'sini authenticated private retrieval handlerına bağlamak
rollback: Bu paketin retrieval route ve testini geri al; mevcut belge, ödeme, teslimat ve veritabanı verilerine dokunma
acceptance: Retrieval authenticates and enforces invoice/workspace/document ownership
Only clean private document artifacts are returned
Provider URL and document storage key never reach the client
Missing or unauthorized documents use a non-disclosing response
